source: Pump.fun Memecoin Corpus, replayed through the app's narrative pipeline
method: Flagged categories against the rest at the same reads, on coins launched afterwards, each against all coins launched then. 90% ranges from a moving-block bootstrap over days (2-day blocks; 4-day for 3-day outcomes). Signal rules were fixed before this test and not tuned on it.
caveat: Preliminary: about two weeks of one market period from one corpus, with no out-of-period test. Readings six hours apart share outcomes; categories differ greatly in size, so one category can carry a comparison. Many comparisons were run, so a single range just clear of zero is weak evidence.

working.label: marked “working” this week
working.text: Marked “working” this week came before better outcomes: the coins that followed graduated 1.15× the market against 0.90× (difference +0.25, 90% range +0.17 to +0.31; flagged on 11 of 12 days, 13 readings, 401 graduations). It rests mostly on one category (Characters & creatures, 100% of the flagged coins); without it the difference is -0.85.

decay.text: Over 14 days and 14 categories that had an edge (379 readings, 16 separate declines), 20% of warned readings were followed by a decline within 3 days, against 12% of the others (difference +0.08, 90% range -0.01 to +0.17): not clear of chance. 80% of warnings were false alarms; 41% of declining readings had one.
decay.text_early: Before a decline showed in results, warned readings declined 8% of the time against 6% without a warning (90% range -0.01 to +0.10; 19 declining readings): no reliable early warning. Of 22 collapses, 10 had a warning first, a median 0.9 days ahead.
decay.text_results: When results had already fallen, 29% declined further against 5% (90% range +0.09 to +0.29): deterioration already under way tends to continue. That is a description, not an early warning.

text_week: Ranking categories by their week did no better than chance at ordering the next day (average rank correlation +0.04, 90% range -0.12 to +0.20; 12 days).
